source.name: RFK Akhmat: Игровая форма ФК «Ахмат» на сезон-2026/2027 (club kit launch)
source.quote: ФК «Ахмат» впервые подготовил чёрно-зелёный комплект игровой формы.
source.note: English: 'FC Akhmat has for the first time produced a black-green playing kit.' The launch photos on this page show 'AKHMAT FOUNDATION' printed across the front of the 2026-27 home shirt.

summary: Akhmat Foundation (Akhmat Kadyrov Foundation) on the shirt front, per the club's official 2026-27 kit launch photos. The club's partners page also lists Mir and Grozny TV, but no shirt placement for them was confirmed; back, sleeve and shorts placements could not be verified from the photos available.
